Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-11-04

1. Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
Daybreak Red introduces the GPT‑5.6 Cyber model to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US‑East) via Amazon Bedrock, enabling authorized cybersecurity work.

2. Training LLM Agents to Automate LLM Post-Training with RSI-Dojo
A team released the first version of RSI‑Dojo, a platform that trains LLM agents to autonomously execute post‑training tasks such as fine‑tuning, evaluation, and hyper‑parameter tweaking. The agents learn to orchestrate the entire pipeline without human prompts.

3. Unsatz: Evaluating Scientific Discovery Without a Given Ansatz
Researchers released Unsatz, an arXiv benchmark that requires a language‑model agent to generate the full ansatz—defining variables, hidden terms, interactions, and measurement—before any equation fitting begins.
